body:
## Problem

`KNOWN_NON_DIFFUSERS_DIFFUSION_MODEL_PATTERNS` (`python/sglang/utils.py`) only carries **org-prefixed** patterns for some entries (`minimaxai/minimax-h3`, `fal/ideogram-v4-*`), while other families in the same list already ship bare-name patterns (`pi05`, `pi0.5`, `hunyuan3d`, `flux.2-dev-nvfp4`).

As a result, a local model directory downloaded by repo name alone — the standard way to point at local weights:

```bash
sglang serve --model-path /data/models/MiniMax-H3 --model-variant fl2va
```

fails in **both** detection layers:

1. **CLI auto-detection** (`is_known_non_diffusers_diffusion_model`, substring-only) misses the path and falls back to the standard LLM server parser, which rejects the diffusion-only args (`--num-gpus`, `--ulysses-degree`, `--model-variant`, ...).
2. **Registry pipeline resolution** (`get_non_diffusers_pipeline_name`, substring-only) misses the path; `maybe_download_model_index` finds no top-level `model_index.json` (H3 keeps it under `FL2VA/` / `Ref2VA/` partitions); backend `auto` then falls back to the generic diffusers pipeline, which attempts a Hub download of the absolute local path and crashes with `HFValidationError`.

Workaround today: symlink the directory to `/data/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3` (matching the org-prefixed pattern) or pass `--model-type diffusion` — but the bare local path should just work, as it does for the other families in the list.

## Fix

Add a **short-name fallback** to the two substring-only matchers, consistent with the short-name matching already used by `_get_config_info` (step 2) and `has_registered_diffusion_model_path`:

- `is_known_non_diffusers_diffusion_model` (`python/sglang/utils.py`): after substring matching fails, compare the directory **basename** against the short names of registered patterns (e.g. `"MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3"` → `"minimax-h3"`).
- `get_non_diffusers_pipeline_name` (`python/sglang/multimodal_gen/registry.py`): same basename fallback, returning the pipeline name.

The fallback uses **exact equality**, not substring containment, so a future `MiniMax-H3.5` or `MiniMax-H3-4B` directory will not false-positive. It only triggers when substring matching already failed, so behavior for every other model path is unchanged; the diffusers-layout models (top-level `model_index.json`) are unaffected.

## Verification

- Unit checks: `/data/models/MiniMax-H3` → detected + `MiniMaxH3Pipeline`; negative cases (`minimax-h3.5`, `MiniMax-H3-4B`, unrelated dirs) → not matched; existing bare-name families (`pi05`, `hunyuan3d`) and HF cache paths (`models--MiniMaxAI--MiniMax-H3/...`) still match.
- End-to-end: `sglang serve --model-path /data/models/MiniMax-H3 --num-gpus 4 --ulysses-degree 4 --performance-mode speed --use-fsdp-inference true --model-variant fl2va` (no `--model-type`, no symlink) starts, loads `MiniMaxH3Pipeline` from `/data/models/MiniMax-H3/FL2VA`, and passes the 1344x768x124f server warmup.

This also fixes the same gap for the Ideogram entries (`ideogram-v4-fast`, `ideogram-v4-instant`, `ideogram-4`), which have the identical prefix-only problem.
